comments.author: ahl
comments.html:
Manu,

We can't wait to get the source code released. Some people are worried that it's going to be a security risk or -- worse -- a risk to Sun's intellectual property. Those risks seem far outweighed by the benefits to people trying to understand the system (with DTrace) and -- even more exciting -- modifying Solaris and contributing code.

comments.author: ahl
comments.html:
Alan,

There are actually 32-bit and 64-bit versions of every library (actually, there are a couple missing on amd64, but we're working on it). As a result, we don't even need to do any of Rod's fancy linker tricks -- we automatically get the the library appropriate for the data model we've chosen.
